original_observation: Movement cannot be understood reliably from one static pose
design_hypothesis: Temporal context should improve phase and repetition interpretation compared with isolated-frame assessment
observable_variables: phase probabilities boundary error invalid transitions and repetition count
supporting_source_or_data: Researcher experience plus temporal test cases
conflicting_source_or_data: to be completed through literature matrix
independent_test: Compare frame/rule-only and temporal/hybrid conditions on grouped real sessions
acceptance_criterion: Lower boundary/repetition error without increased false transitions
reflexive_bias_note: Researcher designed both hypothesis and implementation; freeze criteria before testing

original_observation: Reporting many simultaneous errors can overload immediate correction
design_hypothesis: One evidence-ranked correction should be more actionable than an unprioritized error list
implemented_component: Situation-awareness attention target and feedback suppression
observable_variables: priority target response length correction success and user rating
conflicting_source_or_data: to be completed through psychology/coaching literature
independent_test: Blinded comparison of single-priority and multi-cue feedback
acceptance_criterion: Higher actionability and no reduction in correctness
reflexive_bias_note: Preferred personal coaching style may bias the priority rule

original_observation: Anticipation is useful but uncertain and can be wrong
design_hypothesis: Future-pose evidence should affect coaching only after confidence and agreement gates
observable_variables: prediction confidence agreement error false-warning rate and first-risk time
supporting_source_or_data: ACP-STGAT output evidence and awareness tests
conflicting_source_or_data: to be completed through prediction/calibration literature
independent_test: Compare trusted and rejected forecast cases against observed future frames
acceptance_criterion: Lower false-warning rate than ungated prediction
reflexive_bias_note: Internal experience cannot establish the biological mechanism or universal strategy

original_observation: The same body configuration can mean different things at different moments of a technique
design_hypothesis: Ordered phase state should constrain scoring and repetition completion
implemented_component: Phase classifier duration-aware decoder and state machine
observable_variables: phase order duration boundary and completed repetition
supporting_source_or_data: Automated temporal verification plus synthetic model output
conflicting_source_or_data: real participant annotations not yet available
independent_test: Test manually annotated complete partial noisy and out-of-order repetitions
acceptance_criterion: Correct rejection of invalid transitions and lower completion error
reflexive_bias_note: Phase decomposition reflects researcher interpretation and selected techniques

original_observation: A useful coach remembers repeated patterns rather than treating every frame independently
design_hypothesis: Session and learner memory should support repeated-error and personalized pacing decisions
implemented_component: L3 session layer and L4 user layer
observable_variables: repeated mistake count trend recommended speed mastery and consistency
conflicting_source_or_data: longitudinal participant evidence not yet collected
independent_test: Compare decisions with and without session/user history across repeated sessions
acceptance_criterion: Improved expert relevance rating without unsupported personalization
reflexive_bias_note: Researcher expectations of learner progression may not generalize

original_observation: Declining control can require slower pacing or reset rather than another technical cue
design_hypothesis: A non-medical fatigue-risk proxy may prioritize slow-down and reset actions
implemented_component: L3 fatigue proxy and situation warning
observable_variables: form-quality trend repetition timing fatigue-risk score and warning decision
independent_test: Compare proxy against expert labels and future sensor measurements
acceptance_criterion: Report sensitivity/specificity and avoid medical interpretation
reflexive_bias_note: Visual decline may be caused by tracking or unfamiliarity rather than fatigue

original_observation: Some movements may contain avoidable displacement or inefficient force transfer
design_hypothesis: Multimodal biomechanical measurement may identify technique variants with measurable efficiency differences
observable_variables: joint displacement force impulse movement time co-contraction and physiological cost
conflicting_source_or_data: to be completed with biomechanics literature and sensor protocol
independent_test: Controlled within-participant comparison using calibrated sensors and predefined efficiency metrics
acceptance_criterion: Statistically and practically meaningful improvement without reduced task performance
reflexive_bias_note: Do not call a traditional method energy-wasting before objective comparative measurement
